newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toray Italy venture to boost synthetic suede plant.
newsitem.headline: Toray Italy venture to boost synthetic suede plant.

text.p: Toray Industries Inc said on Tuesday its Italian joint venture with Mitsui & Co Ltd would spend 153 billion lire, or about 10 billion yen, to expand its Italian facility for producing synthetic suede.
The plant is in Mera Montoro in central Italy, about 180 km north of Rome.
As result of the expansion, the factory's annual production capacity for the suede material will jump from 4.5 million square metres to 9.5 million square metres, Toray said in a statement.
The joint venture, Alcantara SpA, will begin full production using the expanded capacity in July 1998.
Toray also said the increased production would enable the joint venture to expand its marketing of furniture and automobile parts made with the microfibre material in Europe.

After the expansion, Toray's group production capacity for the material will total 13 million square metres per year, the statement said. The Toray group's world market share is expected to rise to more than 50 percent by 2000, it also said.
The joint venture is 70 percent held by Toray, while the remainder is held by Mitsui.
